s: Im muttar lehitannot berosh hashshana ubo t' seipim: yesh omerim shemmitzva lehitannot berosh hashshana ubeshabbat teshuba kemo bekol aseret yeme teshuba, veen halaka kedibrehem, ella asur lehitannot berosh hashshana veshabbat teshuba kemo sheasur bishar shabbat veyom tob. Vaapillu raa chalom ra vesapeq lo im hu mehachalomot shemmitannin alehem beshabbat — lo yitanneh. Umitzva leekol velishtot velismoach berosh hashshana kemo shennitbaer besiman tqp"a, omnam lo yoklu kol sobam lemaan lo yaqellu rosham vetihyeh yirat Hashem al penehem:

Yesh meqomot sheqqabbala beyadam shekkol mi sheragil lehitannot berosh hashshana umeshanneh regiluto veeno mitanneh — eno mashlim shenato. Umikkol maqom mi sheeno yare lenapsho — en tzarik lehitannot kol yamayv, raq tzarik hattara kishar neder:

Hammitanneh berosh hashshana tzarik lilmod kol hayyom o lomar techinnot, shehare kol yom tob tzarik lechalleq chetzyo laHashem vechetzyo lakem, kede leqayyem shene pesuqim shebbeechad katub "laHashem" ubeechad katub "lakem", vezeh shehu mitanneh veeno meqayyem hammiqra shenneemar bo "lakem" — tzarik laasot kullo laHashem, kede leqayyem hammiqra shenneemar bo "laHashem" velo neemar bo "lakem", umashma shekkol hayyom yihyeh laHashem lebaddo:
Hammitanneh berosh hashshana o bishar yom tob — asur lo lebashshel o laasot shear melakot okel nepesh letzorek acherim kemo shennitbaer besiman tqk"z, ayyen sham hattaam:

Yesh omerim sheqqabbala beyadam shehammitanneh paam achat berosh hashshana taanit chalom im haya beyom rishon shel rosh hashshana tzarik lehitannot shene hayyamim shel rosh hashshana kol yamayv apillu keshechal beshabbat, hoil veheru lo siman ra paam achat behatchalat rosh hashshana ballayla harishon ramezu lo shettaanito chabib lipne haqqadosh baruk hu berosh hashshana, lepikak yaaseh retzono veyitanneh kol shene yamim shel rosh hashshana shehen keyom echad arok kemo sheyyitbaer besiman t"r. Abal asur lehitannot ballelot shel rosh hashshana kemo bishar yom tob, sheap bachalomo lo ramezu lo ella lehitannot bayyom, kederek kol taanit chalom sheen mitannin ella bayyom:

Veim heru lo hachalom beyom sheni shel rosh hashshana — yitanneh kol yamayv yom sheni bilbad velo yom rishon. Umikkol maqom, mi sheeno yare lenapsho — eno tzarik lachosh leqabbala zo, veeno tzarik lehitannot kol yamayv kelal lo beyom rishon velo beyom sheni, ap shehaya hachalom beyom rishon:

Hammitanneh berosh hashshana taanit chalom — eno tzarik lesheb bechol taanit al taanito kemo hammitanneh beshabbatot ubeyamim tobim ukemo shennitbaer besiman rp"ch, shehare yesh omerim shemmitzva lehitannot berosh hashshana, veap al pi sheen halaka ken, mikkol maqom keday hem lismok alehem leinyan shello nachaziq taanit zo laabera sheyyitztarek lehitannot bechol bishbil kak:

Ap al pi shemmi sheqqibbel alayv lehitannot beshabbat o beyom tob en qabbalato kelum umuttar leekol belo hattara kemo shennitbaer besiman tq"a, mikkol maqom mi sheqqibbel alayv lehitannot berosh hashshana, ap al pi shello hotzio bilshon neder ella bilshon qabbalat taanit beolma sheamar "hare alay lehitannot berosh hashshana" — tzarik hattara, meachar deyesh omerim demitzva lehitannot — en zeh kimqabbel alayv laabor abera sheen qabbalato kelum.
Vehannohagin lehitannot berosh hashshana — lo yomru "anenu", kemo sheen omerim "anenu" beyom hakkippurim, mippene shehen yeme din veen shayyak lomar "beyom tzom taanitenu":
